data.body: Closeability assessment 2026-09-08: all recorded ACs/follow-ups are satisfied or split out. AC1 fsmonitor/untrackedCache were removed from the shared ~/rebar config, live fsmonitor daemons were explicitly reaped, and later sessions no longer spawn full-worktree fsmonitor daemons. AC2 stale worktrees were pruned in two operator-approved rounds (120 -> 21, with only active/tickets worktrees retained). AC3 host observability is live through launchd mem-sentinel, including memory pressure, fseventsd/mds RSS, fsmonitor count, python/git counts, PPID-1 counts, top RSS, and orphan sweeps. AC4 local MCP/gate leak was root-caused and closed separately as centauric-gnomic-hake (7495-36ea-df75-4a3d): Serena full-checkout MCP servers held by orphaned harnesses were the leak class; all harnesses were repointed to the read-only mirror and repo change 2725 removed the tracked Codex precedence trap. Additional related landed work this session covers MCP request self-heal (skaldic-carbon-copperhead, change/commit abb3d8243653, canceled MCP offloads no longer starve workers) and host liveness alarms (enzymatic-revivable-pheasant, commit 429b60cc2391, CloudWatch alarms for Gerrit/review-bot/memory-probe/container-stats heartbeats). Remaining one-week soak is explicitly split to feministic-unmetalled-xerus and is not close-time evidence for this incident ticket.
